context_and_flow.screen_type: A mobile app dashboard or widget screen showcasing macronutrient intake and energy balance.
context_and_flow.ux_intent: To inform the user of their daily caloric and macronutrient status.
ux_patterns: The Macro Balance widget uses a bubble chart visualization for fat, carbs, and protein.
The Net Energy widget includes a horizontal scale slider ranging from -500 to 500.
The interface is very clean, using whitespace effectively.
